did_you_know.fact: On October 2, 2004: The first parkrun, then known as the Bushy Park Time Trial, takes place in Bushy Park, London, UK.

October 2 is observed as Independence Day, celebrates the independence of Guinea from France in 1958.
On October 2, 2005: Typhoon Longwang made landfall in China as the deadliest tropical cyclone in that year to impact the country.
